beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:b6.title: Growth Lead
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:b6.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon Software is a permanent capital holding company which acquires and grows essential businesses. We are a profitable Series C firm that combines great technologists, operators and M&A professionals to accelerate the scale of the ambition of the dozens of businesses we own and operate. We are supported by capital from tier-1 venture capital, crossover, and endowment investors as well as the founders of the leading technology companies from the past decade. We are growing our team in Toronto, San Francisco, and New York. Apply below. You’ll be joining Beacon’s Acceleration team: a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists. We work closely with portfolio companies to solve problems, create and implement playbooks, and build new features and products. ABOUT THE ROLE Beacon Software buys businesses. You get to grow them. Specifically, you’ll design and run go-to-market experiments for a pod of 3-4 companies we’ve acquired in a particular industry (education, industrials, parks & rec, etc). This can take any shape: you might launch ads, cross-sell into other portfolio companies, game plan a conference, scrape high-intent lead lists, write copy, or vibe-code a dashboard. To put it another way, you’ll be a fractional head of growth, with an eye towards systems and playbooks that generalize across portfolio companies. We’re looking for an animal who can go into a business, ask the right questions with little context, launch experiments, and drive revenue. Basically, we’re looking for The Wolf https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOZB6mNqhuA, but for growth. WHY WOULD YOU WANT THIS ROLE? - Get a first-person view into the world of private equity, rollups, and AI. - Access proprietary learnings about vertical SaaS businesses in a variety of industries. - Work with a team of former YC founders, growth leaders, and execs at Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies (Instacart, AngelList, Retool, and more). - Have loads of control and autonomy over what you work on. - Be artsy AND sciencey. - Like writing copy and brainstorming video ideas? You get to do that. - Like reading investment memos and deeply understanding businesses? You get to do that, too. - Ample LLM token budget. - Meaningful equity in a hyperscaler that’s already profitable. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES - Asher https://www.linkedin.com/in/akingabramson/: Former cofounder of Demand Curve (YC S19). Has grown multiple startups to millions in annual revenue. - Safwaan https://www.linkedin.com/in/safwaan/: Former EIR & investor at Founders Inc., former Chief of Staff to a well-known entrepreneur - Brent https://www.linkedin.com/in/brent-jensen/: Former growth @Together Software (YC S19) & Roadmunk, both companies acquired for 8-figure sums. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Meet with your pod leader and portfolio company GMs, marrying product direction with user learnings to brainstorm growth experiments. - Prioritize, build, and launch experiments that meaningfully drive revenue. - Identify and optimize growth loops at portfolio companies. - Track and improve conversion at every major step of the marketing funnel. - Build systems (e.g., playbooks, Claude skills, mini-products) that less technical GMs and portfolio company employees can use to run GTM experiments themselves. - Hire other great growth people. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Former founders and growth marketers/GTM engineers with a track record of cracking growth channels and loops, ideally in B2B SaaS. - Strong growth fundamentals: prioritizing channels, breaking down funnels, developing ICPs, automating prospecting and leadgen, copywriting, CRO, etc. - Clear, concise writing. - Comfort saying no to the wrong priorities. - Enough vibe-coding chops to be dangerous, but not a man-with-a-hammer. - Software engineering or finance background is a plus, but not required. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. Whether you are an established growth leader or a rising star with a track record of moving markets, we care about your ability to drive momentum. If you have the instinct to identify trends before they happen and the operational discipline to lead a global team, we will give you the resources to define the next generation of digital marketing. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Growth Architecture: Design and execute the overarching marketing strategy, focusing on aggressive user acquisition and high-velocity retention loops. - Viral Orchestration: Lead our content and partnership teams to ensure Partyhat is consistently at the centre of the cultural conversation. - Algorithmic Dominance: Use deep data analytics and proprietary tools to master the algorithms of X, Discord, and Telegram, ensuring our message hits the right audience at the right time. - Resource Allocation: Manage the marketing budget with surgical efficiency, deciding where to double down and where to sunset campaigns based on real-time ROI data. - Brand Velocity: Oversee the visual and narrative consistency of the brand, ensuring we maintain a "premium but degen" aesthetic that resonates with a global audience. - Strategic Leadership: Act as the primary bridge between Product and Community, ensuring our marketing efforts are perfectly synced with our technical roadmap and operational goals. THE REQUIREMENTS - The "General": You are a battle-tested leader. You know how to manage diverse teams, from designers to growth hackers, and keep them focused on elite execution. - Market Intuition: An innate ability to read the room. You understand sentiment, "vibe shifts," and how to pivot strategies in minutes, not months. - Hyper-Availability: This isn't a 9-to-5. You must be available 7 days a week to lead the team through viral moments, market shifts, and 24/7 global launches. - Data Mastery: You are obsessed with metrics. You don't make guesses; you make moves based on hard evidence and predictive modelling. - Web3 Literacy: You live on-chain. You understand decentralized communities, tokenized incentives, and the unique psychology of the modern digital asset holder. - Operational Excellence: Self-motivated and highly organized; you can manage a complex global marketing machine without losing track of the small details. OPERATIONAL DETAILS - Location: Fully Remote. - Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to manage a global team and 24/7 market cycles). WHY JOIN US? We offer more than just a leadership role; we offer the keys to a high-growth engine. - Extreme Autonomy: We value results over red tape. You will have the freedom to build and execute your vision using our streamlined Ashby and Linear workflow. - Global Impact: Lead a brand that is building the future of internet-native experiences for a massive, worldwide audience. - A Culture of Momentum: Join a team that moves at the speed of light. You will be constantly challenged to innovate, scale, and outperform the market. - High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For those who take extreme ownership, there is a clear runway to shape the future of the entire organization.

As a member of GI Alliance (GIA), Gastroenterology Consultants of San Antonio (GCSA) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven gastroenterology network that is physician-led. This partnership empowers GCSA to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging GI Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our physicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Practice Opportunity Employed Position for the first 2 years, with Partnership Track Local Autonomy with National Resources Generous Financial Package Relocation Allowance, Signing Bonus & Annual CME Great Work/Life Balance Lifestyle San Antonio is a family-friendly city with top-rated school districts, family-oriented attractions such as the San Antonio Zoo and SeaWorld, and numerous parks and recreational facilities. It is a great city to raise a family. The city offers a high quality of life, with a mild climate, diverse dining options, cultural events, and outdoor recreational opportunities. The city's River Walk, historic sites like the Alamo, and numerous festivals contribute to its vibrant atmosphere. The city is ideal for outdoor activities year-round. Enjoy hiking, biking, or water sports on nearby lakes and rivers. San Antonio residents pride themselves on their strong sense of community and civic engagement, with endless opportunities to get involved in local organizations and community health initiatives. Protected salary with bonus potential for the first 2 years 3rd year partnership track with ASC ownership buy-in potential, additional ancillary income, and restricted stock grant Shared call - Light rotation #LI-JC1 Patients Come First. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move!
